newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Sept state sector profits down 28.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Sept state sector profits down 28.5 pct.

text.p: China's state industry posted profits of 22.636 billion yuan ($2.73 billion) in the January-September period, down 28.5 percent from a year ago, the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
It quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying that the figures were for state enterprises covered in the central government budget.
Losses from companies that were operating at a deficit reached 14.101 billion yuan during the first nine months, up 23.0 percent from a year ago, Xinhua said.
China has been trying to reform its state-run enterprises, which are often overstaffed and unable to compete effectively either in the domestic or export markets.
Losses are a huge drain on the central government's budget but political leaders have been reluctant to allow large enterprises to go bankrupt for fear of creating social unrest.
